items.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016
items.q: I played with Pepper Adams when he was there.

ctx.x: Did you get into accompanying those visiting jazz musicians?
Oh yes. Oh yes. I was in the local trio. I played with some nice musicians. For example I played with Pepper Adams when he was there. That was very interesting.
